LONG-RUN FOLLOW-UP (2026-08-14): sampled eight recent completed Verify runs 31835218274 through 31848073556. macOS job queue was 1-4s in seven runs and 3s in the eighth; all used the identical macos-26-arm64 image version 20260728.0273.1. The macOS default tier varied from 21m12s to 28m09s and integration from 2m01s to 3m17s, so the >30m tail in this window is execution variance, not runner queueing. The recurring only individual >30s test phase was tests/unit/workflow/test_editor.py::test_server_binds_loopback_only setup at 35.0-35.1s; nested runtime instrumentation on run 31846417650 attributed 35.013s to socket.getfqdn and below-threshold time to bind. Gerrit 1795 owns the RED/GREEN fix.

The same instrumented default tier emitted 260 fixture_setup spans over 1s totaling 380.393 aggregate worker-seconds (not additive wall time). Excluding the 35.020s editor fixture, the largest file-level fixture totals were test_secret_screen_e7a9.py 28.998s/23 setups, test_list_filters.py 25.856s/17, test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py 19.230s/7, test_prepare_reclaim_backup.py 16.486s/11, and test_inline_write_push.py 12.846s/9. This identifies repeated real git-store construction as the next coverage-neutral optimization seam. Prior ticket peculiar-calmy-bubblefish explicitly deferred ~20 module-local fixtures after its template-copy repair cut tests/interfaces from 270.7s to 186.5s (31%) with more tests, so this is accepted prior art rather than a rejected proposal.

macOS post-step/control-plane finalization was 50-81s across all eight runs. The instrumented warning-heavy run was 81s, but pre-instrumentation runs were already 50-76s and warning-free run 31848073556 was 70s. That falsifies the proposed warning-fanout explanation as a material unique cause; no logging A/B change is justified.
